summary: [4A6R 修正] Board Analysis runtime 与 market_aggregation publication 在 canonical Review 计算/发布链（canonical_decision_consumers）上确实已无决策消费者——stock_core / Unified Review compute / Unified Review publish 均不依赖 Board artifacts。但 canonical 独立性 ≠ 全局无消费者：当前仍有真实 ACTIVE 消费者——(1) 前端 BoardAnalysisPage / Board 分析 API（ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONSUMER，读取 BoardAnalysisSnapshot 并触发 compute_all_boards/compute_board_analysis），(2) system_overview_service 板块节点（ACTIVE_PRESENTATION_CONSUMER，读取 BoardAnalysisRun 计算 status/coverage/quality_gate/blocking_reason/recommended_action），(3) product_readiness_service board_aggregation 节点（ACTIVE_MONITORING_CONSUMER，读取 market_aggregation pointer + BoardAnalysisRun lineage 计算 READY/DEGRADED/PENDING/LINEAGE_MISMATCH，且 is_mandatory=True）。因此 retirement 必须分开表述：canonical 层安全、产品/界面层尚不安全。迁移顺序必须是 consumer-first（改 BoardAnalysisPage 数据源为 Unified Review canonical board scope）→ admin monitoring 迁移 → 停 producer（AfterClose compute_all_boards / market_aggregation publication）→ 最后清理 legacy 模型/schema。

after_close.detail: AfterClose still RUNS compute_all_boards as a mandated legacy side-product. Its failure does not block stock_core or Review (compute or publish); it only downgrades the overall AfterClose run status to PARTIAL_SUCCESS and records aggregation_status in metadata/diagnostics. Its artifacts are not consumed by any canonical downstream calculation that produces Review data (Review producer never reads BoardAnalysisSnapshot payload).

frontend_api_consumers.classification: computed BoardAnalysis snapshot API consumer (CASE C — legacy frontend Board snapshot API remains)
frontend_api_consumers.note: This page reads computed BoardAnalysisSnapshot payload and can trigger Board compute-all. It is a real ACTIVE consumer of the legacy Board runtime, exposed to authenticated (and admin) users. Removal of the Board stage / market_aggregation will break or empty this page unless Unified Review provides equivalent info or the page is explicitly retired.

retirement_decision.afterclose_rationale: canonical_safe: No stock_core / Unified Review compute / Unified Review publish decision depends on the Board aggregation outcome; compute_all_boards is a legacy side-product and Blocking only downgrades PARTIAL_SUCCESS. product NOT safe: the running /boards product still consumes fresh BoardAnalysisSnapshot, and admin monitoring (system_overview, product_readiness) still depends on BoardAnalysisRun / market_aggregation pointer. Stopping the producer now would starve those live consumers.
retirement_decision.marketagg_rationale: canonical_safe: market_aggregation pointer has zero canonical decision readers (production and publish of Unified Review independent). product NOT safe: product_readiness board_aggregation node (ACTIVE_MONITORING_CONSUMER, is_mandatory=True) and system_overview board node depend on this pointer / BoardAnalysisRun; stopping the writer leaves them PENDING/stale.

blocking_consumers.kind: ACTIVE_PRODUCT_CONSUMER — legacy Board snapshot API (CASE C)
blocking_consumers.decision: MUST be rewired to Unified Review before stopping producer, per product rule: merge Board Analysis into Unified Review while preserving board-analysis functionality. Do NOT simply hide/remove the page.
After migration to Unified Review board scope, update node to source from Review's board observation (or drop node). Migrate before producer stop.

blocking_consumers.kind: ACTIVE_MONITORING_CONSUMER of market_aggregation pointer + BoardAnalysisRun lineage (is_mandatory=True)
blocking_consumers.decision: After migration, source board readiness from Review canonical observation or relax is_mandatory. Migrate/retire before market_aggregation publication stop.
